name: Raw | Organic 1 1/4 Cones | 6pk
description: Raw Cone Pre-Rolled Rolling Papers are perfect for people who don't know how to hand-roll. They are the ultimate convenience in rolling because you only need to fill them up with whatever you like to smoke, twist off the end and light up. 6 pack.
